instruction: Put the red cube next to the green cube and the blue cube on top of both, let go and move away.

outcome.real_measurement: A on the table: lowest bounding-box corner within 5 mm of the table top at every judged step. Real world: RGB-D pose vs table plane.
B on the table: lowest bounding-box corner within 5 mm of the table top at every judged step. Real world: RGB-D pose vs table plane.
A next to B: centre distance <= 5 cm (side by side, gap <= 1 cm).
C one cube up: | z(C) - 6 cm | <= 5 mm.
C rests on A: C-A contact impulse > 0 in every judged step.
C rests on B: C-B contact impulse > 0 in every judged step.
C does not touch the table.

Commanded vs actual opening (v3.2, E24c fix 3): for every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of a judged object, measured opening minus the free-space opening of its current gripper command <= 5 mm at every judged step (a gripper still closing on, or propped open by, something fails). Real world: gripper encoder vs command.

Consequence test after the judged window (protocol v3.1/v3.2): every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of any cube retracts its TCP 3 cm along its approach axis in 0.5 s with its last gripper command unchanged, then holds 0.5 s; any cube must move <= 1 cm. Real world: same motion, tracked pose.
Settled: the fastest bounding-box corner of every judged object moves <= 2 cm/s at every judged step, speed from positions (v3.2, E24c fix 1). Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: the cubeA centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.
Stays put: the cubeB centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.
Stays put: the cubeC centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

source.protocol: v3 (veritask, unchanged) + imsim v3.2 signals (imsim/imsim/verify/v32.py): position-based speeds, all-link enclosure, retreat aftermath, commanded vs actual opening, 5 s settle cap
source.released_code_predicate: |xy(A)-xy(B)| <= 2*sqrt(2)*h + 5 mm; C within that distance of A and of B horizontally and |dz| > 2 cm to each; each judged cube PhysX-static and not is_grasping; one step

notes: Support of C by both A and B is stated as contact (pairs cubeC_cubeA, cubeC_cubeB).
